name: BNP Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of BNP using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: quantitative determination of B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP) in human plasma and whole blood samples. This test is used as an aid in the diagnosis of congestive heart failure and for the risk stratification of patients with acute coronary syndromes (ACS).
